senses.gloss: m. (שקי) drink, liquid, infusion.—Pl. שַׁקְיָינֵי, שִׁיקְ׳.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 6:3">Targ. Y. I Num. VI, 3</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 78a:6">Sabb. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>כל ש׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שתייתא</he>) all liquids (infusions of collyrium) heal &c., v. <cite ref="I00509"><he>טְלַל</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147b:9">Ib. 147ᵇ</cite> <he>כולהו ש׳ מדיבחא וכ׳</he> all infusions (medicines) taken between Passover and Pentecost are efficacious.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:4">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>כולהו ש׳ קשו וכ׳</he> (not <he>שקיינו</he>, Rashi <he>שַׁקְיָינִין</he>) all liquids are bad for the ear, except &c.
